reviews.text: Dr. Lotus was wonderful.  She provided a thorough exam, explained her recommended treatment and followed up with phone calls providing lab results and checking on my cat's recuperation. Thank you.

I am extremely dissatisfied with the way my pet was treated and with how your clinic handled this situation.

Providing me with an incorrect emergency hospital address was a serious mistake. Because of this, I lost an entire day, spent unnecessary money, and, most importantly, my pet lost valuable treatment time. I then had to seek care at another clinic, resulting in significantly more expenses, time, and stress.

I am also very disappointed with the charges from yesterday. My pet’s previous test reports were already available, so I do not understand why I was charged for services or testing that had already been completed.

This entire situation was caused or made significantly worse by incorrect information provided by your clinic. I do not consider the way this was handled professional or acceptable.

I am requesting a full refund of yesterday’s charges. Please have a manager review this matter and provide me with a written explanation of the charges and how your clinic intends to resolve this issue.

I expect this complaint to be taken seriously.

If I could, I wouldn't give them a single star. Their work attitude was appalling. I came all the way from Massachusetts, and the clinic was completely different from how I had described them over the phone. They showed no patience or compassion in handling even urgent cases, demonstrating a complete lack of professionalism.

I don't understand your reply. You gave me the wrong address, causing me to miss my pet's treatment time. I called you this morning, but you didn't answer. You know you made a mistake, but you won't face me and keep making excuses. No one can accept spending several hours driving to your company, wasting a whole day, with no progress, yet you're charging me for various tests. I had the same tests done in Massachusetts and have already given you the reports. You're avoiding the issue and have absolutely no professionalism.
Do NOT go to this hospital! Their staff are rude, they gave me the wrong address, overcharged me, and caused my pet to miss out on timely treatment.

It NOT a good practice when they care about the revenue vs what I really requested.

I brought my dog to this veterinary office because I specifically wanted her to be seen by a particular doctor who had been recommended to me. I arrived late to my appointment, but I was not told that the appointment would need to be rescheduled.
I clearly explained that I wanted the doctor who had been recommended to me. I did not agree to see a different doctor. Unfortunately, at the time I could not remember the doctor’s name, but I made it clear that I wanted the veterinarian I had originally been referred to.

The office proceeded with another doctor. My dog received her regular vaccines, including rabies and Bordetella. My issue was not with my dog receiving her routine vaccines; I was upset because I specifically wanted the doctor who had been recommended to me and did not realize that a different veterinarian would be seeing her.

After the visit, I checked my messages and was able to confirm the name of the doctor I had originally been recommended. I then asked the office if that doctor could review what had been done and contact me by phone. I wanted to make sure the veterinarian I had specifically requested could review my dog's records and the care she received.

I was told that the doctor would not call me because of the way I reacted at the office. I understand that I was upset, but I was frustrated because I felt that my request had not been respected. My concern was my dog and making sure she was seen by the veterinarian I had specifically asked for.

I am disappointed with how this situation was handled. If a client specifically requests a particular veterinarian, the office should make sure the client understands which doctor will actually be seeing their pet, especially when the client has made it clear that they came specifically for that doctor.

I am still requesting that the veterinarian I originally wanted review my dog's visit and contact me. Until I receive the information and clarification I requested from that doctor, I am not comfortable paying the outstanding balance. I am disputing the bill pending review of my dog's visit by the veterinarian I originally requested. I am requesting that she review the examination, vaccines, and records and provide clarification. I am willing to resolve the bill once this review is completed.

I hope the office can resolve this professionally. My only goal is to make sure my dog received the appropriate care and that my original request is taken seriously.
This is the best pet doctor they are friendly caring and keep my cat alive. They are amazing all doctors there are top notch.
Found problem, with my 15 year old cat, she has chronic lymphocytic leukemia

Dr Lotus is absolutely wonderful! She is very kind, knowledgeable, and helpful. She was thorough yet gentle during my cat's check-up and addressed all of our concerns. I really appreciate Dr Lotus and the staff!

Have been bringing my dogs here for many years and have always been happy with service. Dr Benson is great, he takes his time, and listens to your concerns. The staff are patient and very friendly and easy to communicate with. If ever I have an issue they always take their time to help.
Live 35 minutes from office. Yet I travel because of the staff and service.

This is an okay place. Most of the doctors are good and staff are friendly.

However, there's usually  40 min - 1 hour wait from your appointment time, while they can cancel the appt if you are 15 min late.

Also they make it very inconvenient for medication distribution. You need to pick up the paper prescription, they don't sent it to the pharmacy. There are also multiple times they didn't give me enough medicine for the treatment period (idk if this is because they didn't calculate correctly) so you need to go back several times to refill.

Parking is easy.

The doctors at this animal hospital are wonderful, and I truly appreciate the care they provide. Unfortunately, my experience with the front desk staff has been extremely disappointing.

My cat had an emergency and had blood on his face. I went to the hospital earlier that morning, but they were unable to see him at that time. I understood that and respected their scheduling policy.

However, when I later arrived about 10 minutes late for my appointment because a work meeting ran over, they refused to see my cat at all, even knowing that he was having an urgent issue.

What upset me even more was the attitude from the front desk. I did not feel any compassion or concern for an animal that was clearly in distress. Instead, I felt like my cat and I were simply being treated as an inconvenience or an annoying customer.

I completely understand that a hospital needs policies and that being late can affect the schedule. But this is also an animal hospital, and I would expect the people working at the front desk to show at least some empathy when an animal is injured and bleeding.

Again, I have had very positive experiences with the doctors here. My frustration is specifically with the front desk staff and the way this situation was handled. I left feeling angry, disappointed, and honestly shocked by the lack of compassion.

Very disappointed with how this practice handled my dog’s medication. Their prescription was authorized for only 6 months instead of the expected year, causing my 1-800-PetMeds autoship to fail and leaving my dog 2 weeks overdue for NexGard/Heartgard.

When I came in asking for a single dose to bridge the gap, I was told they couldn’t provide one. Instead, I had to purchase a 6-month supply of NexGard PLUS for $207 because they don’t carry regular NexGard.

What bothered me most was the customer service. The younger female receptionist was argumentative and dismissive, and when I asked for management I was essentially told to “just come back Monday when the manager is here.” There was little acknowledgment that the medication gap resulted from the prescription issue in the first place.

I’ve asked management to remediate the situation and will update this review based on how they respond.
They are very on time appointment, friendly with the pet and the owner, and everything it's very clear, thank you so much.

It takes awhile to hear back from this clinic. I had to ask a few times over email and calling to receive medical documents.

Not to mention, my cat had giardia and hearing back for results for a positive took lots of follow-up as the receptionists kept telling me the vet would call later that day (never happened). It took a week to hear back.

Please spend your money elsewhere.

Dr. Benson was my dog’s veterinarian for ten years. I trusted him, but he somehow failed to hear an advanced heart murmur another veterinarian at The Pet Doctor quickly diagnosed. I brought her in for regular echocardiograms after I learned about the murmur, and spent tens of thousands on her care, only to find out that her subsequent heart failure could have been delayed if Dr. Benson had followed standard protocol and prescribed Vetmedin for her. Instead, he prescribed Atenolol, which is contraindicated for heart failure, and caused my dog to repeatedly turn blue and collapse due to lack of oxygen, until she died a tragic, and unnecessarily early death.

I like how informative the doctor was and his plan of treatment. Instead of making us do all the unnecessary (for now) tests, he understand budget is a huge thing and work with us to make sure our pet still get the care he needs.
Made a mistake with my dogs prescription was out 100 bucks because of it front desk talks to you like they hate their job and have miserable lives

I asked for a refill on my dogs prescription PILLS. They sent the prescription through the mail for a liquid. I called the prescription place and they said it was called in for liquid not pills. The medications costs me $100 dollars.  The pharmacy said they could not take it back. So I called the vet to resubmit the prescription properly for pills. I called the pet doctor and brought  it to their attention
that the prescription was written wrong and I needed a new one. Now I am out $100 dollars for the wrong one and it cost me $100 dollars for the correct  one and The pet doctor didn't really care about their error and didn't offer me any kind of compensation  on a future vet visit or anything. Didn't really seem to care

I recently brought my dog, Moka, to The Pet Doctor for an urgent care visit, and I could not be more grateful for the experience.

From the moment we walked in, the staff immediately stepped out from behind the front desk to greet Moka and show her some love. She was clearly not feeling her best, and I could see her mood improve right away. That level of kindness meant a lot to both of us.

Dr. Ibrahim was incredibly gentle, patient, and compassionate. He took the time to examine Moka carefully and made us feel comfortable throughout the entire visit.

I also appreciated how easy it was to get an appointment right away. Having a trusted clinic so close to home is a huge plus. The in-house pharmacy made everything even more convenient, and we were able to leave with the medication Moka needed for her colitis without any extra stops. As a dog parent, I even loved the thoughtful touch of receiving her medication in a paw-printed paper bag.

The entire process was smooth and efficient. We were in and out in no time, yet never felt rushed.

Thank you to Dr. Ibrahim and the entire team at The Pet Doctor for your kindness, professionalism, and excellent care. I am very grateful for the experience and will absolutely continue bringing Moka here whenever the need arises.

We went for the very first, health visit, for our new puppy. Very clean place. I didn't wait too much. I instantly liked Dr. Koo. Seems very knowledgeable and has a very nice, relaxed personality.
He is a keeper, say woof-woof. 😉😄

This clinic will do some unnecessary bug check which costs 200.
And the doctor try to con me to believe my dog have MPL leve 2-3 for left leg and level 4 for right leg and charge 5k per leg for surgery.

After doing many second opinion check, the left leg is level 1-2 and right leg is 2-3.

Even idiot can tell that the dog with level 4 MPL cannot use his leg at all!

I would say that if the clinic try to inflate the bill by doing unnecessary check, what else can you trust him?

Look at the video I post, does it look like level 4 most series MPL on his right leg?

We are deeply grateful to the entire team at The Pet Doctor of Flushing for saving our puppy Miya’s life. The doctors and nurses showed incredible patience, compassion, and dedication throughout one of the most difficult times for us.

Their genuine love for animals and their determination to fight for every little life truly touched us. Without their hard work, care, and persistence, Miya would not be here today. Even though Miya still has future surgery ahead, they gave us hope when we felt hopeless.

Thank you for never giving up on our little puppy. We will always remember the kindness, professionalism, and humanity shown by everyone at The Pet Doctor. We truly believe Miya is alive today because of you.

Overall, the experience was quite good; the staff were very welcoming and provided detailed explanations, and the environment was relatively clean—free from any particularly strong odors. However, the sole issue was the lack of Chinese translation services. This significantly complicated language communication, leading to difficulties in promptly and effectively communicating with the hospital staff to address my kitten's illness. This was the one aspect that left me feeling very disappointed.

All people there are very nice and polite. We didn't need to wait to be attended. Doctor Camila Nieto was very nice and polite. She is very knowledgeable and answered all our questions. She checked Messi, gave him vaccinations, explained us everything. Also they provided full service, cut nails, brush teeth. Doctor Camila Nieto responded our call late at night, because Messi had an allergic reaction to one of the vaccines. We follow her recommendations and Messi was Ok in a couple of ours.
They give appointments so that the doctor could make you wait while he's on the phone . Cause only his time is valuable.
Love my pups Dr I've been coming here for about 3 years

I have been thinking of coming here for a while and never did. Yesterday my fur baby passed out, was vomiting and was constantly going to the bathroom. Essentially, I was in a panic. The first vet I thought to call was The Pet Doctor. I called and the woman Jenn was so pleasant on the phone, she told me if I needed to come in they would accommodate me. I'll be honest, I was anxious but she was so patient. I called, booked my appointment - they didn't charge me a "same day fee" like other places, which I really appreciated. I brought my baby girl in and I was met with smiles. The front desk staff were so kind, I was seen a little before my appointment time and met with Dr. Warner. She was so attentive, let me speak, listened to me because I was in a bit of a panic. She really was great. They examined my dog, she made recommendations and I proceeded with everything she suggested. I took my fur baby home with medication she suggested and I believe she will be just fine. I didn't get the feel that they just wanted my money, I believe they genuinely care for the animals they treat. This is my new vet now. I won't be going elsewhere. Thank you guys so much! I really appreciate all the staff, they were all so personable.

Update: 04/03/2026
I took my fur baby for her annual wellness visit. The vet was so nice. I wasn't see right away, but that's fine. There were quite a few other pups there but all of them were friendly. As always the staff answered all my questions, gave me some resources and I didn't feel rushed. I never mind waiting here because when it's your turn, the vet will listen to you, ask the appropriate questions and really give you some great information. Thanks again Pet Doctor!

The pet doctor is great. Me and my sister have been going here for a while with our pets and we love it. The staff is friendly and they are always ready to answer any questions or concerns we have. My cat recently got sick and luckily the pet doctor had last minute open appointments. She is doing so much better and I am just glad to have had the pet doctor available for us. Despite the long distance from us we still choose to come to this vet. 100% recommend.
Great attention to our concerns and great care for our "puppy"!!!!
Listened and addressed my concerns. Office staff very friendly and you can tell they love animals.

Dr Thomas and the entire staff (vet techs, front desk, everyone) has been so so kind, helpful, and empathetic. I brought in a stray cat in need a couple of times and they took great care of her, bathed her, and were very understanding and empathetic to my situation. It’s nice to see part of the community respect and love animals the way I do!
Dr. Peterson takes his time to explain what's going on with my babies and does what's best for them

I took my dog to see Dr. Thomas yesterday for the first time. He is 13 and having an issue that his regular vet was not resolving.  Dr. Thomas was kind, thorough, honest and upfront and I am confident from just this one visit that she now has my dog on the right path.  I will definitely be continuing his care with her going forward!

What's my first time there. After many years at another vet where we had a very bad experience.We decided to take our business elsewhere. We were greeted by Christine... or Chrissy as co workers called her. She was lovely, kind and listened to all of my concerns with my dog.  The place is clean and the wait time was not bad. The doctors were very knowledgeable  and I felt like I made the right choice for my fur baby.

Doctor Peterson is very honest, professional, and caring. The nurse holding my puppy was gentle and reassuring, and the front desk lady was warm, friendly, and helpful—even during my phone conversation. Everyone worked together to make my puppy feel safe and comfortable. Highly recommend this clinic for compassionate and trustworthy veterinary care!

The staff is not transparent about pricing. They provide inaccurate estimates and place blame on inexperienced staff. However, they still expect you to pay for the mistake they made on their end. They seem to be great with pets but they are sketchy with their pricing.
Whenever I bring my fur babies here, I always feel taken care of!

I’ve been going to pet Dr for years now… My cat who is not very people friendly needed to be looked at. I advised the tech that he might need to be sedated but she said no let’s try… And her and Dr. Benson were able to treat my cat without any problem and she even trimmed his nails for me in five seconds!
What a pleasure to deal with people that have such great experience under their belt! I would trust any pet with these doctors!

Our  cat was cared for recently by Dr. Thomas and her vet tech, Mia.   Both were so loving, gentle,  and funny, and they have a knack for putting pets and people at ease.    This is a practice that is associated with the animal care center shelters  in NY, where we first got our foster cat.  As a result of us now being foster failures (we have adopted Tomtom ) the bonus -- in addition to all the amazing, wonderful things the @NYCACC does - is that we were given this extra visit by the ACC.  There are several veterinarians associated with the NYCACC scattered here and there and Pet Doctor Of Flushing was the one closest to where we lived.    Dr. Thomas did a thorough exam (on a very skittish cat) and Mia knew how to handle him to allow the Dr. to do her work.    We were able to get all our questions and concerns answered.  The practice has a large supply of pet food products and flea protections, so one can purchase right there.    For those who are driving there, be aware that parking is available on the street and side streets and we were able to find a spot.  But we were not there at a super busy time, so just a heads up about giving some time to park.   For all Pet Doctors, veterinarians, techs, lab workers, and shelter workers who do such caring, king, patient and compassionate work for animals:  thank you, and may you all have a  healthy, gentle and happy New Year. Sincerely,  Tomtom's family.
Great service and very friendly staff.
The staff is kind and attentive and Dr. Halpern is a fantastic veterinarian.
Topnotch service. Beautiful bedside manner of both Dr. Ibrahim and Tony. Our cat Merlin was very well taken care of.

*Professional care
*Appointment availability when emergencies arise.
*Very nice friendly welcoming office staff.

I called at 20 minutes before closing as Dave had a bloody toe.  The front desk was wonderful and told me to come right in.  The Vet was kind and caring and saw us right away.  I felt very secure in knowing that they took good care of my Dave.
My doctor Retired in july or august he was a good vet.
If I could give zero stars, I would. Avoid this place at all costs. They do not care about your fur babies. Only$$$

I brought my dog to The Pet Doctor Veterinary on Friday for an issue with his eye. When I returned on Monday to pick up his medication, I politely asked the receptionist if I could speak with the doctor to ask a simple follow-up question about my dog’s condition. She told me I would need to book an entirely new appointment and pay for another full visit — even though it was directly related to my most recent one.

The staff is consistently unhelpful and dismissive. Every visit feels like an uphill battle just to get basic care or answers. It’s honestly shocking that this place has such high ratings given the way they treat clients and handle business.

$250 for a 15-minute consultation, and then they expect you to pay again just to clarify something from that same visit? This place is an abomination to pet care. They seem far more interested in money than the well-being of animals.

Save your time and your money. Go to Long Island Spay and Neuter instead — they have an excellent, compassionate staff who genuinely care about your pets.

Came with my pet to check if my pet wound is healing properly, The doctor literally moved his tail, took a look and said it’s healing nice , I specifically called before the appointment,They told me there’s no charge for this check only for a physical check., They did charge me $100 for physical exam that never took place,The doctor never checked my pet ears teeth heartbeat, Nothing at all , After I insisted talking to the doctor,the doctor,kept  claiming that he did the physical exam which was not true, Secretary was not happy about me complaining and looked impatient, I was in the same room and the doctor did not examine my pet,and still they charge me $100 for this. Unacceptable And Very unprofessional.
Helpful with diagnosing, providing updates and easy appointments for my new puppy. All the staff have been helpful and sympathetic
Been going to Pet Doctor for over 20 years. It is obvious that everyone who works there truly loves animals.

Unfortunately, I need to write a negative review for a place I once loved. I trusted the Pet Doctor with my dogs for the last 12 years. On Monday, September 8th, I called them hysterical asking to take my very sick dog in. I knew it was her time. I was on hold for 7 minutes before anyone came on. I begged for an emergency appointment only to be put on hold again. The person came back on and said the doctor cannot see her. She is booked. I expressed that my dog was dying and needed to be with the vet she knew her entire life. Again, she puts me on hold. Comes back on and says there is no way they can see her. I was devastated. I ended up rushing her to VEG in Carle Place where they were compassionate and caring. They helped her cross the rainbow bridge.They let us hold her until the very end.
I understand that you are busy but how can you turn away a family that has let you care for both of their dogs for years? She needed to be where she knew.
I called to update them. The person that answered the phone said: “I’m sorry. I’ll update the file.” and hung up…. Really?

I was a customer for 16 yrs and I’m Never going here again. Make sure you check your bill bc they add unauthorized charges on your bill and then when they’re questioned they tell you there’s nothing they can do abt it.
excellent doctors but very, very expensive looking for another good Doctor without the Bayside Whitestone prices

You need to change your front desk. As a dog parent I would never want to take him to a place where the receptionist is nasty over the phone. I wanted to schedule an appointment with any doctor that was available but not only was she sighing over the phone, when I asked her questions her tone was "no duh?". Would never trust a place with unprofessional staff. There was another lady that I could hear over the phone and she seemed very informative and helpful. Cancelled appointment.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
The Pet Doctor of Flushing

Wonderful veterinary clinic! The staff is caring, professional, and very attentive with pets. They explain everything clearly and make sure you feel comfortable with the care your pet receives. The clinic is clean, well-organized, and welcoming.

They truly go above and beyond to make both pets and owners feel at ease. I’m very happy with the service and would highly recommend The Pet Doctor of Flushing to anyone looking for excellent pet care.
Took us in Like a Family we are very pleased .

Easy to book the appointment and office communicated that I should come a bit later-always good to know rather than sitting and waiting! Professional, personable, empathetic care for my cat and realistic treatment options. Thank you.

My daughter brought a stray cat just to confirm if it was pregnant.  In front of my daughter ,the vet spent less than 5 minutes feeling the belly and then looking at her nipples.  We were charged for a full pet visit.  The bill arrived and stated vet visit and dental cleaning which was a total lie.  We did not get a full vet visit.  This place is all about business since it is corporate owned.

On 07/23)25 I accompanied a very dear friend whom had to bring her beloved " China" to be put to rest, everyone dreads that Day. I would like to just say that Dr. Biederman was such an extremely Empathetic professional, which helped my friend in " letting go" of dearest  "China" doll. Dr. "B" wasn't China's primary vet, Pet Clinic was chosen for the time  availability. Staff was wonderful as well. Everyone has " good & " bad" experiences but at this dire time, Dr. Biederman, in my opinion was the very Best !!
They really need to ex plain   the fees more clearly
The absolute best! And my dog deserves the best. They’re the kindest and sweetest to my teddy 💕 …

The best veterinarian, everyone in the office is very welcoming and lovely! There is no communication barrier due to language, and my dog peed on the floor. Dr. Britny Thomas is like an angel, helping me solve the problem of my dog's fracture. She is very professional and friendly! She is very patient. If I don't understand something, she will patiently translate and explain it to me! I am really glad to be here! Don't worry if you have any language problems, you don't have to worry or worry when you come here! This will be your best choice!
20 minutes on hold just to schedule an appointment.

I wish I could give this place zero stars. If you love your pet like family, please—do not come here.

We had been bringing our dog to this clinic for nearly 10 years. We trusted them. We followed every recommendation, scheduled yearly checkups, and came in any time he seemed unwell. We believed we were doing the right thing.

But that trust was shattered when we took our dog to an emergency vet and found out he was in chronic liver failure—something that had clearly been developing for a long time. The emergency team reviewed his history and pointed out abnormalities that had been visible in past test results—signs that should have been investigated more thoroughly. Signs that, if caught earlier, could have given him a chance.

Instead, we were left with no options. I had to make the heartbreaking decision to put my dog down because his condition had become irreversible. And the most devastating part is knowing it could have been prevented with proper care.

This clinic failed him. They failed us.

If you’re reading this, please find a vet who will truly care about your animal, who won’t just go through the motions, who will catch the small things before they become tragic. You only get one chance with your pet’s life—make sure you entrust it to someone who takes that responsibility seriously.
Nyla and Shya were super helpful and informative.
Excellent - Dr. Benson is the best.
LOVED  THAT U CAN NOW GO IN WITH YOUR DOG. EVERYONE WAS SO FRIENDLY TO ME AND MY DOG. VET WAS GREAT WITH HER AND FUN TO TALK WITH !

The best doctor in our area!!! Not a corporate entity posing as a vet. After a terrible experience at North Shore Animal Hospital in Bayside, I returned to my original vet. I didn't leave for any other reason than I wanted boarding and vet together. Well, I'll manage.  This is a DOCTOR'S office not corporate like North Shore. At the Pet Doctor of Flushing you get to speak to the doctor,  and not get denied from it because an office manager is playing doctor like at North Shore. (ie giving prescriptions and not hearing you).   Dr. Benson and his staff are kind and empathetic.   End result is they heard my concerns, explained things rationally,  I left satisfied with the dosage and care for my dog.  I'd give 10 stars if I could.  This is a veterinary office not a business posing as a veterinarian where corporate decides for your dog and when you make the request to speak to the vet they deny you because the vet is not the boss here.     Be careful people.  Go to Pet Doctor of Flushing.  I'll never leave again. 6
